notes.title: [2025.3.3 Update]Major UI and Functional Interface Update
notes.notes:
Update Notes:
Added CG Gallery - Album feature.
Optimized UI for Settings, Album, Load, Save, Help, and Confirmation screens.
Added new button sound effects.
Optimized mouse cursor skins.
Improved the game ending teaser video.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45122455/f638fdcf67ca2488d067ef5b4855804641f77bbe.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45122455/fc60b51821cc7d7883a08a3e94598494303e81e4.png[/img]

The team has been busy revamping the UI before and after the holidays, and we’ve finally wrapped up this phase! Looking back at the old UI now, it feels like a completely different era.

Currently, Chapter 3 is nearly complete. Once Chapter 4 is finished, we’ll release an early access version. The demo will also be further optimized and iterated based on feedback. Stay tuned!

notes.title: 【10.13 Update】Explore the All-New Chapter 2.5
notes.notes:
In search of the Snowdrop Flower, Ivan and his companions set off on a journey, only to face the expected challenges along the way.
A group of strangers suddenly appeared in the tavern, demanding their lives...
A simple meal nearly turned into a deadly encounter...
They were attacked by unknown creatures in the forest and fell into a cave...
At the police station, they witnessed a twisted and evil experiment...
A glimpse of their hidden pasts was also revealed.
Don’t skip the ending—there’s a sneak peek of the upcoming PV!
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45122455/28865b4e9af0b5bf2b6611f53f95a3cfe3f3603f.png[/img]
The full choice-driven gameplay takes about 40 minutes. We hope you enjoy it!
In celebration of the New Releases Festival, we're excited to bring you this update. If you're interested, please consider adding us to your wishlist—it would mean the world to us! Thanks a bunch! ❤️

A friend mentioned that the video was lagging badly, so we've compressed and optimized the code in the prologue. If there are still issues, please don’t hesitate to contact me—thank you so much!
Also, a streamer friend showcased the demo (old version) on Bilibili. We're incredibly grateful, as this provided lots of optimization ideas for our team. Interested folks, feel free to follow and give them some support!

notes.title: A Letter to the Adventurers
notes.notes:
Adventurers, greetings.

I am Liaoya, the producer of End's Beginning. After a somewhat lengthy development period, the DEMO version of End's Beginning is finally here for everyone to experience. We look forward to sharing a romantic and fantastical adventure with you.

Due to our limited technical capabilities, the game is still rough around the edges. If you encounter any issues while playing, we welcome your suggestions in the comments section. Alternatively, you can provide feedback to the development team through any of the following communities:

Official QQ Group: 873210170
Weibo/Little Red Book/Bilibili: 三更梦工作室（Please copy this Chinese username to search）
QQ Email: 1322503980@qq.com
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45122455/dee579602bfba0ebe6c1ce401b33181e64885fa2.png[/img]
Upcoming Development Plans:
Develop content for chapters 2 to 5.
Optimize some effects and visuals in the prologue.
Add more interactive options and improve the affinity system.
Create the epilogue.
Add character voiceovers.
Add Japanese and English versions.

The operations team will also continuously release new activities and content, including CG artwork and scene production processes, live gameplay, character mini-theaters, live streams, and more. Stay tuned!
